cohort.exclusionInherited: 68 prior IDs (STEP 20 calibration 23, STEP 20 holdout 13, STEP 32 32) and STEP 20 / STEP 32 window starts +-72 h

design.1_scientificQuestion: On an independent, source-complete cohort (STEP 36; Gulf Stream box, 2010-07..2010-10), does (Q1) the ocean temporal representation of the frozen HYCOM baseline (native 3-hourly vs UTC-daily mean) materially change 72 h drifter-trajectory agreement, and (Q2) does the frozen candidate (GLORYS12V1 15.810070 m + WW3 Stokes x 1.0 + NCEP-R2 windage alpha 0.002) reproduce lower observed-vs-model position error than the frozen HYCOM baseline?

2_primaryHypothesis.statement: Paired 72 h M3 error of the candidate minus the HYCOM baseline has a negative median across the cohort AND the candidate has lower error in at least 2/3 of non-tied drifter pairs (CANDIDATE_DESCRIPTIVELY_FAVORED under the locked STEP 30A rule).
2_primaryHypothesis.null: H1-null: the locked rule yields NO_CLEAR_DESCRIPTIVE_DIFFERENCE or HYCOM_DESCRIPTIVELY_FAVORED.

3_secondaryHypotheses.statement: Paired 72 h M3 error of HYCOM_DAILY minus HYCOM_NATIVE_3H has a non-negative median with >= 2/3 consistency (NATIVE_3H_DESCRIPTIVELY_FAVORED) - i.e. temporal representation matters.
The H1 label is unchanged when alpha = 0 (structural pair) is substituted for alpha = 0.002 in both models.
The sign of the H1 median delta is the same at 24 h and 48 h.

design.4_observationalTarget: NOAA GDP hourly drogued drifter positions (STEP 15 archive, observation SHA 22c0ecff..., unchanged) of the 20 STEP 36 drifters at exact UTC t0 + 24 / 48 / 72 h
design.5_predictionTarget: 72 h open-loop Lagrangian trajectory from the drifter position at t0 (12:00Z) with output every 900 s; position at t0 + 24, 48, 72 h
6_independentVariables: ocean forcing identity: HYCOM_NATIVE_3H (A), HYCOM_DAILY (B), GLORYS + Stokes candidate (C)
structural windage alpha: 0.002 (primary) and 0 (robustness pair only)
7_dependentVariables: M3 observed-vs-model haversine position error (km) per drifter and horizon
paired delta (km): E_C - E_A (H1), E_B - E_A (H2)
M1 endpoint displacement, M2 path length, M4 model-model separation, M5 observed displacement (descriptive)

8_primaryEndpoint.name: nested paired median 72 h M3 delta (candidate minus HYCOM), Theta
8_primaryEndpoint.definition: Theta = median_{w in W*} [ median_{i in V_w} ( E_C,i(72h) - E_A,i(72h) ) ] with E_X,i(h) = haversine(model position at t0+h, observed position at t0+h), R = 6371008.8 m; ties |delta_i| <= 1e-6 km
8_primaryEndpoint.aggregation: nested: median of valid drifter-pair deltas within each window (Delta_w), then median across windows (Theta); equal window weighting; the pooled drifter-level median is secondary
8_primaryEndpoint.validSampleRule: a pair is valid at h only if the candidate trajectory, the baseline trajectory and the observation all exist at the exact UTC timestamp t0+h; no interpolation, nearest matching or imputation
8_primaryEndpoint.missingValues: NOT_AVAILABLE, counted and reported; never imputed; n and NA reported per horizon
8_primaryEndpoint.comparison: locked STEP 30A interpretationRule (docs/research/step30a-rule.json, unchanged) evaluated on the pooled valid drifter pairs (pooled median sign and wins/(wins+losses) >= 2/3, wins and losses counted over drifter pairs nested in windows) - this descriptive label is a different statistic from Theta and is reported together with the window-level consistency count (number of windows with Delta_w < -1e-6 / > +1e-6 / tied) as descriptive context
8_primaryEndpoint.successCriterion: H1 supported only if the descriptive label is CANDIDATE_DESCRIPTIVELY_FAVORED AND the window-level bootstrap 95 % percentile interval of Theta is entirely < 0 km; otherwise H1 not supported; the label, Theta and the interval are reported in every case

hierarchy.level1: window / cluster (9 STEP 36 windows; shared forcing period, release time and regional flow state)
hierarchy.level2: drifter pair nested within its window (20 drifters; one candidate-vs-baseline pair per drifter per horizon)
hierarchy.level3: trajectory evaluation points (900 s output samples and the 24/48/72 h evaluation instants) nested within a drifter pair
hierarchy.independenceRule: trajectory evaluation points are NEVER treated as independent statistical observations for the primary inference; the primary inference unit is the window; drifter pairs are observations nested within windows; pooled drifter-level statistics are descriptive
hierarchy.notation: V_w = set of drifters i in window w with a valid 72 h pair (candidate position, baseline position and observation all exist at exactly t0+72h); delta_i = E_C,i(72h) - E_A,i(72h) in km; W* = set of windows with |V_w| >= 1
hierarchy.windowStatistic: Delta_w = median_{i in V_w}(delta_i)  (median of the valid drifter-pair deltas within window w; for an even |V_w| the arithmetic mean of the two middle values)
hierarchy.primaryStatistic: Theta = median_{w in W*}(Delta_w)  (median across the window-level medians; equal window weighting; a window with |V_w| = 0 is excluded from W* and counted as NOT_AVAILABLE, never imputed)
hierarchy.formula: Theta = median_{w in W*} [ median_{i in V_w} ( E_C,i(72h) - E_A,i(72h) ) ]
hierarchy.weighting: equal-window weighting (each window contributes one Delta_w regardless of its drifter count); the pooled drifter-level median median_{i in union V_w}(delta_i) is reported as a secondary descriptive statistic for comparability with STEP 30A / STEP 32 and never replaces Theta
hierarchy.aggregationChoice: nested median (preferred rule of the STEP 37 clarification); chosen deterministically before any data acquisition
hierarchy.appliesTo: primary endpoint (72 h, C vs A); the same nested rule is used for H2 (B vs A) and for the 24 / 48 h secondary endpoints

8_primaryEndpoint.mathematicalConsistencyCheck: the label (pooled-pair rule) and Theta (nested statistic) are distinct, well-defined quantities; requiring both is a conjunction, not a contradiction; no inconsistency was found

9_secondaryEndpoints: H2: paired median 72 h M3 delta, HYCOM_DAILY minus HYCOM_NATIVE_3H, with the STEP 32 temporal label rule
24 h and 48 h paired median deltas (both comparisons)
M1 / M2 / M4 / M5 descriptive statistics per condition

10_evaluationMetrics.M3: haversine position error at exact UTC t0 + h, R = 6371008.8 m
10_evaluationMetrics.M4: trajectory separation between two models at h
10_evaluationMetrics.statistics: median (primary), mean, min, max, n, NA, wins / losses / ties per horizon and stratum
10_evaluationMetrics.code: identical implementation to STEP 32 evaluators (tools/research/evaluate_step32_temporal_r2.py, evaluate_step32_validation_r2.py); reused verbatim or byte-compared

11_baselineModel.name: HYCOM_NATIVE_3H (A) = frozen reference baseline
11_baselineModel.ocean: HYCOM GOFS 3.1 GLBv0.08 expt_53.X reanalysis, 0.08 deg, 3-hourly instantaneous, 15.000 m
11_baselineModel.nullModel: the baseline itself is the null for H1; for H2 the null is 'no material temporal-representation effect' (label NO_CLEAR_TEMPORAL_DIFFERENCE)

12_candidateModels.name: GLORYS12V1 15.810070 m + WW3 GLOB-30M CFSR Stokes drift x 1.0 + NCEP-R2 alpha 0.002
HYCOM_DAILY (same source/grid/depth as A; UTC-daily mean of the 8 native frames, label 00:00Z)
12_candidateModels.role: temporal-representation comparator for H2, not a candidate for selection

design.13_modelSelectionRule: NONE in this experiment: the candidate set is fixed (C only); no model is chosen from cohort results; the outcome is a descriptive label under the locked rule; any final operational model selection is a separate future decision requiring its own preregistration and independent evidence beyond this cohort
design.14_parameterSelectionRule: all parameters fixed before execution: alpha 0.002 (STEP 20 lock 73fafffb), Stokes coefficient 1.0 (STEP 29), HYCOM depth 15.000 m, GLORYS native level 15.810070 m, RK4 300 s, output 900 s, duration 259200 s, bilinear space / linear time interpolation, cos(phi) each stage, boundary policy STOP_AT_FIRST_CROSSING, computation area = window ocean box clipped to +-40 deg; no parameter is tuned on the STEP 36 cohort; no calibration subset exists in this experiment

15_forcingSelectionRule.candidates: fixed by product identity; no forcing product is chosen by performance

forcings.temporal: daily mean, sampled at 3 h instants by linear interpolation (STEP 29 construction)
forcings.version: as served by the Copernicus Marine toolbox at acquisition; version string recorded from the file
forcings.endpoint: official Copernicus Marine toolbox (authorized credentials; STEP 25B mechanism)

forcings.product: WW3 GLOB-30M CFSR surface Stokes drift (uuss/vuss), IFREMER hindcast, product_version 1.0
NCEP-DOE Reanalysis 2 10 m u/v, 6 h, gaussian grid

15_forcingSelectionRule.deterministicRule: each condition uses exactly the product listed; identical wind file per window for all conditions
15_forcingSelectionRule.fallback: if any registered source is unavailable or a mandatory frame is missing for a window: WINDOW_BLOCKED for that window in every condition; no alternative product, version, interpolation or reconstruction; if the Copernicus credential check fails: CANDIDATE_BLOCKED (H1 not evaluable), H2 may still proceed on A/B

design.16_initializationRule: release at the observed drifter position at t0 = window start (12:00Z), one particle per drifter, IDs sorted; positions from the STEP 36 manifest (startLon/startLat), never re-derived
design.17_integrationRule: frozen research runtime (services/research-runtime byte-identical to commit 155995dd; model surface-passive-advection.v2.windage 0.1.0, source SHA 306a5976...), RK4 300 s, output 900 s, 72 h; STEP 20 B-3 segmentation (36 h split, union mask) only where a 25-frame dataset exceeds the runtime value limit; separate-process replay of every run

18_temporalResolution.C: 3 h instants (GLORYS linear-in-time between daily labels + WW3 native 3 h)

19_spatialResolution.C: 1/12 deg GLORYS native (WW3 0.5 deg bilinearly sampled onto GLORYS nodes)

design.20_interpolationRules: bilinear in space, linear in time, exactly as the frozen runtime; no extrapolation; no nearest-neighbour substitution; longitude convention: the STEP 36 boxes are -180..180 (Gulf Stream); NCSS requests use the dataset's native convention and the reader's axis normalization is verified against the box before use - any convention mismatch is STEP-BLOCKED, never patched
design.21_landSeaMasking: landMask = wet-validity union over all frames of the dataset (reader rule); condition B mask must equal condition A mask (registered identity) else FAIRNESS_MASK_MISMATCH -> STOP; C mask = GLORYS wet mask OR invalid WW3 stencil; masked nodes carry null, never zero
design.22_missingDataRules: a missing mandatory HYCOM frame in [t0 - 1 d, t0 + 72 h + 1 d] blocks the window (all conditions); no interpolation, duplication, substitution, reconstruction or fill; observation gaps at t0+h make the pair NOT_AVAILABLE at that horizon
design.23_qualityControlRules: B2 gate of STEP 32 reused: source identity, file integrity (SHA/bytes), coordinates (identical axes, 0.08 step, box coverage), time axis, variables, spatial and temporal coverage, missing frames, units m/s, release stencil (ocean and wind), reproducibility (overlap frames bitwise equal; reader re-run) -> PASS / WINDOW_BLOCKED / FAIL; WW3 gate of STEP 29 (identity, SHA, variables, units, 3 h axis, extent, release stencil, licence)
design.24_exclusionRules: inherited immutable STEP 36 exclusions; no drifter or window added or removed; no post-hoc exclusion of any valid pair; no outlier removal, trimming, winsorization or weighting
design.25_failedTrajectories: a particle terminated by the runtime (OUT_OF_DOMAIN at +-40 deg, FORCING_UNAVAILABLE at a grid edge or masked node) has no position at later horizons -> NOT_AVAILABLE at those horizons; reported per condition; never re-released, never replaced
design.26_incompleteObservations: exact-timestamp rule only; a drifter with no observation at t0+h is NOT_AVAILABLE at h for every condition; drogue-loss rules are already applied in STEP 16 eligibility and are not re-applied

27_statisticalTestPlan.primaryDecision: locked STEP 30A descriptive rule on pooled pairs AND window-level 95 % interval of Theta < 0 (see 8_primaryEndpoint)
27_statisticalTestPlan.interval: cluster bootstrap of the median delta (see 28/29)
27_statisticalTestPlan.nominalTest: two-sided exact sign test on wins vs losses reported as nominal context only (n >= 10), never as the decision
27_statisticalTestPlan.inferenceUnit: LEVEL 1 window = cluster and primary inference unit; LEVEL 2 drifter pair nested within window; LEVEL 3 trajectory evaluation points nested within pair and never independent observations

28_uncertaintyEstimation.method: window-level (cluster) percentile bootstrap matched to the primary unit
28_uncertaintyEstimation.procedure: for b = 1..B: draw exactly 9 windows from the 9 STEP 36 windows uniformly with replacement (numpy.random.default_rng(20260907), rng.integers(0, 9, size=9) per replicate, replicates drawn sequentially from the single generator); keep every valid drifter-pair delta belonging to each sampled window (a window sampled k times contributes its Delta_w k times); drifter pairs are never resampled independently for the primary interval; recompute the complete primary statistic with the identical nested rule: Theta_b = median over the sampled windows (with |V_w| >= 1) of Delta_w; store Theta_b; if a replicate contains no window with a valid pair it is recorded as NOT_AVAILABLE and reported (count), not silently dropped or redrawn; B = 10000; seed = 20260907

bootstrap.method: window-level (cluster) percentile bootstrap matched to the primary unit
procedure: for b = 1..B: draw exactly 9 windows from the 9 STEP 36 windows uniformly with replacement (numpy.random.default_rng(20260907), rng.integers(0, 9, size=9) per replicate, replicates drawn sequentially from the single generator)

keep every valid drifter-pair delta belonging to each sampled window (a window sampled k times contributes its Delta_w k times); drifter pairs are never resampled independently for the primary interval
recompute the complete primary statistic with the identical nested rule: Theta_b = median over the sampled windows (with |V_w| >= 1) of Delta_w
store Theta_b; if a replicate contains no window with a valid pair it is recorded as NOT_AVAILABLE and reported (count), not silently dropped or redrawn
bootstrap.interval: 95 % percentile interval = [Q_0.025, Q_0.975] of the stored Theta_b values (numpy.quantile with method 'linear' over the available replicates)
bootstrap.smallClusterLimitation: the primary cluster count is 9 windows; the 95 % interval is an uncertainty estimate under the preregistered window-level resampling scheme and is NOT to be interpreted as establishing asymptotic normality or nominal coverage; the success criterion is not changed because of small n

sensitivity.method: drifter-level percentile bootstrap: resample the valid drifter pairs of the cohort with replacement (n = |union V_w|), B = 10000, same seed 20260907 on a separate default_rng instance, recompute the pooled median delta; 95 % percentile interval
sensitivity.label: ignores clustering; reported next to the primary window-level interval; can never replace the primary result or alter the success criterion

28_uncertaintyEstimation.rationale: the primary interval must match the primary statistical unit (window); drifter pairs stay nested inside their sampled windows

design.29_confidenceIntervals: 95 % percentile interval = [Q_0.025, Q_0.975] of the stored Theta_b values (numpy.quantile with method 'linear' over the available replicates); reported for Theta (72 h primary), for the H2 nested statistic and for the 24 / 48 h nested statistics; the primary cluster count is 9 windows; the 95 % interval is an uncertainty estimate under the preregistered window-level resampling scheme and is NOT to be interpreted as establishing asymptotic normality or nominal coverage; the success criterion is not changed because of small n
design.30_multipleComparisons: one primary endpoint (H1, 72 h) -> no correction; H2 and the horizon/alpha variants are secondary/exploratory and reported without inferential claim; nominal sign-test p-values are context only, so no family-wise correction is applied and none is claimed
31_stoppingRules: acquisition: any registered source unavailable or any mandatory frame missing -> WINDOW_BLOCKED (window), CANDIDATE_BLOCKED (credential failure)

cohort gate after the quality gate: if evaluable windows < 6 or evaluable unique drifters < 20 -> EXPERIMENT_BELOW_MINIMUM: runs may still be executed and reported descriptively but H1/H2 success criteria are declared NOT EVALUABLE
immutability: any frozen-file SHA change -> STOP

32_successFailureCriteria.H1_supported: label CANDIDATE_DESCRIPTIVELY_FAVORED AND cluster-bootstrap 95 % interval of the median delta entirely < 0
32_successFailureCriteria.H1_notSupported: any other outcome (reported with the label and interval)
32_successFailureCriteria.H2_supported: label NATIVE_3H_DESCRIPTIVELY_FAVORED or DAILY_DESCRIPTIVELY_FAVORED AND the interval excludes 0
32_successFailureCriteria.noOperationalClaim: no outcome promotes the candidate or the baseline to operational status

33_sensitivityAnalysis: structural alpha = 0 pair for both comparisons (STEP 29 pattern)
drifter-level bootstrap interval (SECONDARY / SENSITIVITY ONLY; ignores clustering; never replaces the window-level primary interval)
pooled drifter-level median (secondary descriptive; comparability with STEP 30A / STEP 32)
34_robustnessAnalysis: leave-one-window-out: recompute the primary median delta and label omitting each window in turn (9 recomputations; descriptive)
excluding the largest window (GS-Y1, 8 drifters) reported as one of the leave-one-out cases

whole pipeline re-executed into an independent directory: trajectories and result arrays byte-identical; derived datasets grid-SHA identical
validator output byte-identical across two runs

design.39_acquisitionTimeWindow: Phase B acquisition performed after this protocol is locked and reviewed; per window t0 - 1 day .. t0 + 72 h + 1 day (HYCOM), t0 - 12 h .. t0 + 84 h (wind), t0 - 1 day 00:00 .. end + 1 day 00:00 (GLORYS), calendar months covering t0..t0+72h (WW3)
design.40_dataAccessProtocol: HYCOM/NCEP: anonymous HTTPS (NCSS / PSL THREDDS), STEP 17 fetch helper; WW3: anonymous FTP, STEP 23 fetch helper (its shared log append must be avoided - a STEP 32 side effect); GLORYS: official Copernicus Marine toolbox in the STEP 25B isolated venv, credentials via the toolbox only (existence and exit code recorded, contents never read, printed or stored); every acquisition tool runs under a guarded open that aborts on any performance / trajectory file
design.41_checksumRequirements: SHA-256 and byte size for every raw file, normalized dataset, derived dataset, spec, result and trajectory file; grid SHA (canonical JSON) for every runtime dataset; aggregate manifest SHAs bound step to step
design.42_dataFreezePoint: after acquisition + quality gate: the forcing acquisition manifest and quality report are frozen (SHA recorded in the run preregistration) before any daily derivation or model run; the cohort is already frozen (STEP 36)
43_forbiddenPostHocDecisions: changing period, cohort, windows, drifters or exclusions
changing alpha, Stokes coefficient, depth, timestep, interpolation, release or area
choosing forcing, model or parameters from results
replacing blocked windows or substituting sources
replacing the primary endpoint or its rule after seeing results
reporting a below-minimum evaluable set as meeting the minimum
design.44_protocolChangeCriteria: only a defect that makes the protocol non-executable as written (e.g. a tool error, a coordinate-convention mismatch) or an external source change; never a result; a change before any experiment data are accessed is an amendment; after data access it is a disclosed revision with the original kept
design.45_amendmentProcedure: explicit amendment record (docs/research/step37-amendments.json, created only if needed) with: reason, affected fields, old value, new value, timestamp, commit SHA, statement whether experiment data were already accessed; original protocol file never edited; validator re-run and byte-identical
